correctness.rationale: For the repaired theorem, rotation at sample one gives uniform spacings. The disk automorphism gives the two signed arctangents (also for one major gap); the derivative pair comparison proves the regular maximum, including boundary exclusion. The cotangent limit follows from exp(R)/cosh R→2. At a simplex vertex the positive sum of reciprocals dominates the negative 2/s term by 2((n−1)^2−1)/s; elsewhere a small gap forces divergence with no large negative contribution. This supplies the missing localization. Removing two gaps below t^(−a) has o(1/t) probability; the threshold-window comparison and exact Beta/Dirichlet conditionals yield the upper coefficient and joint marks, with excess 1/U, not independent of U. Taylor coefficient H and determinant n yield the lower law. Applying the tail integrals on both ends gives precisely −(n−1)/2<p<1 including p=0, with both endpoints divergent. Replay is the analytic proof in repairs/4/RESULT.md. Inspected the frozen check_cyclic_area_tail.py and VERIFICATION.md; did not run them or infer asymptotic certification from them.

value.rationale: For a natural fixed-n radius limit, opposite ends quantify collision-driven exceptional deficits and regularity-driven small deficits, with explicit frequency constants and geometry. In particular the limit explains why even the first moment is not typical, despite bounded finite-radius deficits. Neither a deterministic area formula nor a mean substitutes for these results.
